1.explanation:
– overlay/index*.md: core documentation for the Overlay component, its positioning logic and props.  
– overlay/demo/scroll.md: demonstrates overlay behavior inside scrolling containers; critical for reproducing the dual-scrollbar positioning bug.  
– overlay/demo/popup.md: shows how popups (like DatePicker) use Overlay for rendering, explaining alignment/offset options.  
– number-picker/index.md: the API doc for NumberPicker where innerBefore/innerAfter props should be declared and documented.  
– number-picker/theme/index.jsx: the theme file that controls how prefix (innerBefore) and suffix (innerAfter) are rendered/styled; key to fixing the misalignment in the arrow icons.
1.bug_scenario: 1. Overlay mis-position: when a page/container has two scrollbars (e.g. window scroll + a nested scroll container), opening a DatePicker popup after scrolling causes the overlay layer to calculate offsets incorrectly and the datepicker-popup appears at the wrong place instead of right under the input trigger. 2. NumberPicker innerBefore/innerAfter styling error: the NumberPicker component supports an innerBefore prop (rendering a prefix inside the input) but does not correctly support innerAfter, so the suffix (increment/decrement arrows) either overflow or are clipped — as shown by the arrow icon sitting outside the input’s border.
